_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for ACN retrospectives (retro/build_acn.py). Every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after that source's 'published' date. The builder uses the latest history vintage published by AS_OF, the prints published by AS_OF that guide a fiscal year after that history, and the events published between that vintage and AS_OF. Values are as reported (no restatements). Edit only to add newly published facts or fix a transcription error against the cited filing. A Q4 print may carry 'fy_actual': the full-year figures it reports, which extend the annual history from its release until the next 10-K vintage supersedes them.
